title: elymus dahuricus subsp. excelsus
intro: Elymus dahuricus subsp. excelsus, commonly known as Dahurian wildrye, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the grass family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to offer various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which are said to help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and gastrointestinal disorders. The therapeutic actions of Dahurian wildrye are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and improve digestion, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
